build_contract.mod_repeatability: Built after the source commit so the DLL and portable PDB embed baseline_commit. The exact DLL is carried in the bundle and promoted by SHA-256.
build_contract.gateway_reproducibility: The image payload is the reproducibility unit. Lumberjacks/.dockerignore excludes .git, and the authoritative image build compiles and tests the solution before publish.
build_contract.sibling_reproducibility: Eventlog, progression, and operatorapi use the same tested source stage and are promoted by image digest.

gateway.identity_check: Test-GatewayImageRelease.ps1 read /app/Game.Gateway.dll from the built image and confirmed it admits m12-motion-20260722-r1.

runtime_config.transport_boundary: Lumberjacks owns authenticated HTTP/JSON ZDO delivery and an observe-first player-motion lane over session-token UDP with binary WebSocket fallback. Native Valheim remains connected and owns simulation, ownership, non-ZDO RPCs, relevance, and presentation unless a tester explicitly enables the local motion apply switch.

deployment.method: Validated release bundle promoted by exact image IDs and mod SHA-256.

limitations: This is the first real Lumberjacks player-motion lane, not a full netcode cutover.
Motion application is off by default; the initial P7 promotion proves carriage before changing presentation.
The first slice broadcasts within one Lumberjacks region and intentionally defers AoI ranking and prediction.
World verification remains required after P7 and both Windows clients carry the same mod artifact.
